item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 6 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 FINAL #NLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 17 August 2026

All RAINFALL WARNING over forecast areas are now terminated.

Light to Moderate rains are expected over #Benguet(Atok, Bakun, Bokod, Buguias, Kabayan, Kapangan, Kibungan, Mankayan, Tublay), #LaUnion, #NuevaVizcaya(SantaFe, Kayapa, Aritao, DupaxDelSur, DupaxDelNorte, AlfonsoCastaneda, Bambang, Ambaguio), #Quirino(Nagtipunan), #Aurora(Dipaculao), #Ifugao(Asipulo, Tinoc), #IlocosSur(Sugpon, Alilem), #Cagayan(Calayan) and #Batanes within the next 2 to 3 hours.

Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are being experienced in #Benguet(BaguioCity, Itogon, LaTrinidad, Sablan, Tuba) and #Pangasinan which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
